content: React Email 6.x consolidated all components + render() into single 'react-email' package; @react-email/components is deprecated (April 2026, 'no longer supported') and @react-email/render standalone still exists but the recommended single dependency is 'react-email'. Pass JSX directly to resend.emails.send({react: <Template/>}) or pre-render with render() from react-email if the react prop path errors.
